bull_case: 유리한 사업·자본배분 가정이 유지되면 기준 점수보다 높은 결과가 가능하다.
bear_case: 성장·마진·자본배분이 정상화되고 핵심 불확실성이 불리하게 전개되면 기준 점수보다 낮아질 수 있다.
thesis: 현재가는 정상화 영업이익 기반 owner-earnings proxy DCF의 Base보다 약 20% 낮다. 대규모 순현금/T-bill이 하방을 지지하지만 Berkshire의 보험·투자 구조 때문에 단순 FCF 정의에는 모델 위험이 있다.

evidence.claim: 2026 H1 operating earnings were $24.329B; Q2 operating earnings were $12.983B.
Insurance and Other held $359.2B cash/cash equivalents/U.S. Treasury Bills at June 30, 2026; borrowings excluding BHE/BNSF were $43.3B.
Current P/B was about 1.47 versus a 5-year average around 1.49.

counterevidence: Operating earnings are not literal free cash flow and include insurance investment income; valuation uses a normalized owner-earnings proxy.
Berkshire's size constrains reinvestment and makes terminal assumptions material.
Q2 2026 net earnings included $12.684B of investment gains excluded from the normalized base.
unknowns: Long-run normalized insurance underwriting margin under Greg Abel.
Sustainable return on the enlarged cash/T-bill portfolio if rates decline.
Post-acquisition economics of OxyChem and Taylor Morrison.
falsifiers: Normalized owner earnings/share falls below the Bear path for two years.
Net cash/T-bill cushion falls materially without offsetting owner earnings.
Price exceeds Bull intrinsic value without a stronger fundamental path.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price $509.77 is below modeled Bull value about $824 and Base about $634.

subscores.rationale: 고정 DCF Base 약 $633.66, 현재가 $509.77로 price/Base≈0.804. signal_map 0.7~0.9 구간=75.
Base terminal fraction 약 62.6%로 80% review 기준보다 낮지만 owner-FCF를 operating-earnings proxy로 정상화한 불확실성이 남는다.
